title: ARPG Mod-Target Scoring Matrix
description: Machine-readable companion to arpg-mod-target-database-2026-05-18.md and arpg-mod-target-ranked-recommendations-2026-05-18.md. Captures the Modding Fit Score (MFS) per candidate target with axis breakdowns. Authored by gandalf 2026-05-18.

kpi_compatibility.description: Does the host model fights similarly to Reincarnated? Spatial substrate, geometry system, range/AOE/AI pattern match, balance methodology.

schema_compatibility.description: How cleanly does Reincarnated JSON output map to host's required input schema?

pipeline_accessibility.description: Official tools / SDK quality, distribution channel, mod-merging, learning curve.

community_vitality.description: 2024-2026 active modder base, reachable audience, mod-creator engagement.

score_interpretation.1: Incompatible / dormant / cannot mod without source

revision_triggers: If top-MFS candidate is commercially impotent, re-weight community-vitality up
If top-MFS candidate requires fundamental engine work that defeats quick-modding goal, re-weight schema-compatibility up
If multiple candidates tie at high MFS, introduce 5th axis: Pipeline maturity (patch-resistance / stability)

scoring_matrix.name: Grim Dawn
scoring_matrix.modding_pipeline: Asset Manager + World Editor + Database Editor + Quest Editor + Lua
scoring_matrix.key_precedent: Dawn of Masteries (53 ported classes); Grimarillion compilation

scoring_matrix.name: Titan Quest Anniversary Edition
scoring_matrix.modding_pipeline: ARC tools (official) + Art Manager + ARZ Explorer + Mod Merge
scoring_matrix.effort_estimate_weeks_incremental_over_p: 2-3 for adapter; plus per-mastery UI art authoring
key_friction: UI authoring overhead: 8+ DBR files + art assets per mastery
Affix library structural mismatch with Reincarnated rolled_effects
scoring_matrix.key_precedent: ShadowChampions Multimaster (Mar 2025); Legion of Champions Reloaded (active May 2026); TQ→GD ports established practice (GD→TQ direction unconfirmed but architecturally feasible)
scoring_matrix.wave_2a_revision_note: Revised down from 3.85 — UI authoring + affix mismatch + smaller community than initial estimate

scoring_matrix.name: Torchlight 2
scoring_matrix.modding_pipeline: GUTS editor (official) + DAT plain-text format + Steam Workshop auto-sync via .sch + Nexus
scoring_matrix.key_precedent: SynergiesMOD (4 new classes — 661k subscribers); TL2-ACE (6 classes + 2 acts); Classes Reborn (40+ classes); 90+ individual class mods in 'New Characters and Classes' collection
scoring_matrix.wave_2a_revision_note: Revised up from 3.50 — DAT text format directly editable (no GUTS required); Workshop auto-sync better than GD/TQ; class injection pattern most-traveled. SynergiesMOD has NO license for third-party builds (drops SynergiesMOD-nest option).

scoring_matrix.name: Terraria (tModLoader)
key_friction: NO runtime JSON path; all content compile-time C#
Per-season cadence requires weekly rebuild + Workshop push
2D side-scrolling presentation requires full art re-authoring at 16-64px native pixel art
scoring_matrix.key_precedent: Calamity Mod (9.18M subscribers); Thorium Mod (3 new classes); kRPG (closest procedural-item analog)

scoring_matrix.name: Minecraft (Forge/Fabric)
scoring_matrix.key_precedent: Vault Hunters (ARPG looter modpack); ~11M active modded-Minecraft monthly

scoring_matrix.name: Rimworld
key_friction: Colony sim loop vs ARPG combat loop
scoring_matrix.key_precedent: Star Wars KOTOR TC; TiberiumRim; Rim-Effect

scoring_matrix.name: Baldur's Gate 3
scoring_matrix.modding_pipeline: BG3 Script Extender v31 (Norbyte, Apr 2026) + official Toolkit (Patch 7 Sept 2024) + in-game mod.io manager + LSX/LSF formats
scoring_matrix.key_precedent: Artificer mod (Nexus 1779); Blood Hunter (2151); 5e Cleric Subclasses Combined (16007); Expansion Level 13-20 (279); 15,000+ Nexus mods
scoring_matrix.wave_2a_revision_note: Revised up from 2.25 — pipeline + community stronger than initial; mechanical fit weaker. Best framed as 'subclass injection per Reincarnated elemental archetype' for community-engagement / brand-presence play, not faithful port.

scoring_matrix.name: Elden Ring
scoring_matrix.modding_pipeline: Mod Engine 2 + Elden Mod Loader + Nexus
key_friction: Souls class system is just starting equipment (no build-system depth)
Audience expects punishing action not procedural ARPG
Shadow of Erdtree DLC 2024 disrupted mod compat
scoring_matrix.key_precedent: The Convergence (new spells / weapons / areas / enemies); ER Reforged

scoring_matrix.name: Dark Souls 3
key_friction: Same Souls audience concerns as Elden Ring
